title: A prospective, non-interventional study to evaluate use of Kinpeygo® in patients with IgA Nephropathy under real-world conditions Non-interventional Analysis and Verification of IgA Nephropathy Therapy Endpoints - The “navIgAte” Study
summary:
Background
IgA kidney inflammation is a chronic kidney disease that can damage the kidney filters over the long term. Kinpeygo is a medication specifically developed to slow the progression of the disease. Physicians want to better understand how to use this medication in daily practice and what changes occur in patients.

Research Question
How do doctors in practice decide when to prescribe Kinpeygo? What physical changes occur in patients over time? How do patients perceive their quality of life during treatment?

Methodology
We observe patients for whom doctors have prescribed Kinpeygo independently of this observation. Over up to 18 months, at regular doctor visits every 3 months, usual measurements such as urine and blood values as well as blood pressure are recorded. Patients complete a short questionnaire (approx. 15 minutes) to describe their well-being. There are no additional examinations or treatments – everything proceeds as in normal medical care.

interventions.name: Patients with IgA nephropathy (IgAN) for whom treatment with Kinpeygo®, independent of study participation, has been decided, will be prospectively observed over an observation period of up to 18 months (with routine visits approx. every 3 months ±4 weeks) regarding disease course, treatment decisio

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Kinpeygo® treatment indicated (physician decision independent of study)
2. ≥18 years with primary IgA nephropathy (IgAN)
3. Able and willing to complete questionnaires
4. Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Hypersensitivity to Kinpeygo® or excipients
2. Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C)
3. Current participation in another clinical study  
4. Kinpeygo® treatment within 3 months prior to inclusion
